title: Jahrbuch der Niedersächsischen Akademie der Wissenschaften zu Göttingen. 2022

creators.name: Niedersächsische Akademie der Wissenschaften zu Göttingen

summary: With its yearbook, the Göttingen Academy of Sciences and Humanities gives an account of its activities in 2020/2021. The yearbook contains the activity report of the presidents and the work reports of the research projects, as well as Academy lectures and lectures by award winners. The new members introduce themselves and the deceased are honored. Translated by deepl
